dataSpec.description: The {@link PdfComponentDataSpec} which specifies the data to be displayed in the {@link PdfComponent}.

data.description:
Data to be shown in the grid. This should be If a list of objects whose attributes match the columns specified in the data spec.
When this field is specified, the data spec action will not be applied.

title: {@link PdfComponent} that adds a data grid to a PDF.
name: PdfDataGrid
